variants.name: Subsonic
variants.info: Uses subsonic .300 BLK ammo. Quieter firing sound with the ability to stay completely off the radar when equipped with a suppressor while offering improved damage performance at long ranges at the cost of poor muzzle velocity and reduced penetration!

variants.name: .223 BTHP
variants.info:
Chambers your UAR A3M2 in .223 Rem BTHP, a hollow point cartridge used for high-precision sport shooting.
Comes with a 10-round magazine offering more mobility, handling and a faster reload while having great damage towards headshots but body damage becomes poor at range.

variants.name: 60rd Drum
variants.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: 20rd Magazine
variants.info: Reduced magazine capacity to increase mobility and handling speed.

variants.name: Armor Piercing
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

variants.name: Hollow Point
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).
